verdict.rationale: Databricks documents first-party headless automation surfaces. The CLI is described for use 'from your local terminal or automation scripts'. The Python SDK is for 'automating Databricks operations', and versioned workspace REST APIs (including the Jobs API) have reference examples via CLI, Terraform and SDKs. YAML-defined workloads can be submitted with `databricks air run`, and Databricks Connect can be embedded in any application. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline integration docs (e.g., CI runner setup, non-interactive service-principal auth in CI), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
